Ashok Dharmanaryan Joshi vs The State Of Maharashtra on 1
March, 2019

Author: Nitin W. Sambre
Bench: Nitin W. Sambre
 1 924) aba190-19.doc
Sas
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.190 Of 2019
 Ashok Dharmanarayan Joshi ..Applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms.Jayshree Tripathi I/b. Udaynath Tripathi for the applicant.
Mr.S.S. Hulke, App for the respondent-State.

Coram : Nitin W. Sambre, J.
 Date : March 1, 2019

It is informed by learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions from the applicant, that Criminal
Writ Petition No.676 of 2019 for quashing of F.I.R. No.848/2018 for offence punishable under
sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv),
27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered with Faujdar Chawadi
police station, Solapur is already lodged.
2.  In the aforesaid backdrop, interim protection ordered 2 924) aba190-19.doc in favour of the applicant is continued for a period of 6 weeks from today.

3. Having appreciated the submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, it can be noticed from the investigation that tobacco pan masala, etc. prohibited articles were seized from the custody of the applicant.
That being so, no case for grant of pre- arrest bail is made out.
As such the application is rejected.
